decisions.reason: As a supporting burner component within the established radiant-heating portfolio, it remains useful for the installed base and system business, even if it is less strategic than the flagship new lines.
This electric infrared panel heater line is a clear strategic product with several models and fits the firm's expansion toward broader, lower-carbon building-climate solutions.

The industrial electric infrared hall heater line serves core non-residential hall applications well, complements the firm's turnkey offer, and should benefit from continued demand for efficient electrified heating.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater remains a flagship direction product with a real operating reference and strong relevance to customers seeking lower-carbon but practical transition-ready heating solutions.
